lines.en: I walk on ice with heavy steps.
My battered axe drags in the snow.
Frost has formed on my armor.
Bones click drily as I move.

lines.zh: 我朝雪林里一步一步走。
lines.en: I trudge toward the snow forest.
The wind parts the rags on me.

lines.zh: 我的靴子陷进雪里，又拔出。
lines.en: My boots sink into the snow and pull free.
There are no eyes in my helm.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下一道深痕。
lines.en: Each step leaves a deep groove.
I cross the frozen river slowly.
Standing, frost on my shoulders.
My breath makes no cloud.
I grip the axe handle.
My head tilts slightly.
Wind passes between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我记不起自己的名字了。
lines.en: I cannot recall my own name.

lines.zh: 我在听冰面裂开的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the ice cracking.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的骨节按回去。
lines.en: I push a loose joint back into place.
This snowfield is quiet.

lines.zh: 霜落在我的肩甲上，没人擦。
lines.en: Frost settles on my pauldron; no one wipes it.
Ice crusts my axe edge.

lines.zh: 雪埋到我的膝盖，我没动。
lines.en: Snow buries my knees; I don't move.

lines.zh: 我的披风挂着一根骨头。
lines.en: A bone hangs from my cloak.
A light out on the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我数着冰面裂开的纹路。
lines.en: I count the cracks spreading over the ice.
I have no need of sleep.
It is cold here, yet you still stand.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，我隔远就知。
lines.en: I sense a living man's warmth from afar.
I have been dead a long time.
Your axe is newer than mine.
This armor was taken.
Do you mean to trade blows with me?
I know the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 雪地上只有我们两个脚印。
lines.en: Only two sets of prints in the snow.
Your hands smell of fur.
Halt. Let me look at you.

lines.zh: 火把烧完，你就看不见我。
lines.en: When the torch burns out, you won't see me.
The snow here buries people for me.

lines.zh: 铁片崩开，露出里面的骨。
lines.en: A plate splits and shows the bone beneath.
A bone has come loose.
I drew back half a foot.
I clench my teeth — except I have none left.

lines.zh: 一根肋骨断在甲片底下。
lines.en: A rib snaps beneath my plates.
I push the broken part back.
Frost falls from the wound.
Frost falls out from between my bones.
You strike fairly well.
A dead man bleeds little anyway.
Do you carry any drink?
That sack. Toss it over.
I never eat anything.
I know that iron.
That thing at your belt.
I want only a weapon.
Too light. Not heavy enough.
Leave it on the snow.
Back off a little.
This haft is still sound.
You hit me. I am cold.
I barely gave a step.
Move. Do not block the way.
Your shoulder met my armor.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一座冰墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wall of ice.
I steady myself on the axe.
Do not squeeze in from the side.
You stepped on my cloak.
Two paths. Split.
I do not yield the path.
I am a heap of bones.

lines.zh: 这具身体不会再有别的。
lines.en: This body has nothing more to give.
These bones froze through long ago.
You are asking a dead man.
I stopped thinking of that long ago.
No such thing on this ice.
The wind is more reliable than the living.
Stand still. Do not advance.
I have no taste for this.
Everyone disperse.
A bone on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把那截骨头塞回甲缝。
lines.en: I wedge that bone back into my armor's seam.

lines.zh: 这骨头是我的旧部件吗。
lines.en: Is this bone mine from before?
I toss it back.
Piece of iron. I keep it.
My bones rattle as I bend.
This is frozen solid.
I lift it with the axe tip.
Something buried in the snow.

lines.zh: 这堆东西里没有能用的。
lines.en: Nothing in this heap is worth taking.
The living are here.
A living thing ahead.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一串我的脚印。
lines.en: A new trail of my footprints joins yours.

lines.zh: 雪地会把你的脚印留下。
lines.en: The snow keeps your prints.
I raise the axe.
You have been marked.
The village is far from here.
Inch by inch.

lines.zh: 雪地上的脚印，我一个不漏。
lines.en: Not one footprint in the snow escapes me.
This axe has felled many.
I need not shout.
You cannot back out.

lines.zh: 你的脚印一直通到我脚下。
lines.en: Your tracks run straight to my boots.
I struck the first blow.
The snow will remember.
Warm blood on snow is such a waste.
My axe is quicker than your feet.
Three counts. I do not wait.
That will do.
Come here and die.

lines.zh: 我让斧柄在掌心转半圈。
lines.en: The axe haft turns half a circle in my palm.
Snow between us.
You retreat, and the trail lengthens.

lines.zh: 我的斧子瞄准你的肩窝。
lines.en: My axe is aimed at the hollow of your shoulder.

lines.zh: 斧子在我手里转了一下。
lines.en: I turn the axe once in my hand.
I do not tire at all.
Your puffs of breath grow shorter.
The trees are too thin for cover.
I measure this stretch.

lines.zh: 冰面上的每一步都在滑。
lines.en: Every step on this ice slips.
Two more strides.
The ice will creak.

lines.zh: 你的心跳震得雪都动了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat shakes the snow.
You looked back at the path.
So be it.

lines.zh: 我把斧头换到另一只手。
lines.en: I shift the axe to my other hand.
I strike now.
No sound on the snow.
I bring it down.
This snow is mine.
The axe comes down from above.
I strike your chest with the axe head.
That blow came with ice chips.
You fell back three paces.
I grab your pauldron.
The sound of bone on bone.
I swing the blade back up with a backhand.

lines.zh: 我的斧头压得你往下沉。
lines.en: My axe bears you down.
I drive my pauldron into you.
That swing was slow.
My axe blade bites into your shield's rim.
Blood shows clearly on snow.
I drag half a step back.
One more axe blow.
I rise from beneath a snowdrift.
My armor is all ice.
The cold here suits me.
I raise my head to the snow forest.
My bones join one by one.
The frozen river is at my feet.
I grip the haft and stand.
Nothing living stirs by the frozen river.

lines.zh: 雪原尽头有火光，我过去。
lines.en: There's firelight at the snowfield's edge; I head for it.
The wind blows the snow off me.
I am dead, yet I must walk.
I drag myself out.
My cloak has frozen stiff.
My breath has no color.
I see you, far off.
First, find the living.
This body still serves.
I start moving.
The ice creaks under me.
I come over the snow.
Fire heats my armor.

lines.zh: 落地时我散了半副骨头。
lines.en: On landing, half my bones scatter.
Icy water floods my armor.
The blast drives me into a snowbank.
An arrow sticks in my chest.
This light slows me further.
The dead do not need to eat.

lines.zh: 电打在盔甲上，一路亮到脚。
lines.en: Lightning lights my armor to my boots.
Colder below than the snow.
